# valid wherever the IG is served from. The publisher resolves canonical-

# Validator bug (not a content defect): binding-checking `Endpoint`/`Organization`
# resource-type codes against ValueSet 'Version Independent Resource Types (All)'
# throws an internal NullPointerException ("Cannot invoke String.equals(Object)
# because system is null") instead of validating, in this repo's `-tx n/a`
# (no terminology server) CI configuration. The codes themselves are correct —
# `Endpoint` and `Organization` are valid resource types — this is purely a
# validator limitation when that particular value set can't be expanded
# offline. Confirmed against the real build on PR #1 / commit ffc5959.
OperationDefinition/tk-endpoint-add-organization-to-endpoint: OperationDefinition.resource[0]: Det angivna värdet ('Endpoint') hittades inte i värdemängden 'Version Independent Resource Types (All)' (http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/version-independent-all-resource-types|5.0.0), och en kod krävs från denna värdemängd  (error message = Cannot invoke "String.equals(Object)" because "system" is null)
OperationDefinition/tk-endpoint-remove-organization-from-endpoint: OperationDefinition.resource[0]: Det angivna värdet ('Endpoint') hittades inte i värdemängden 'Version Independent Resource Types (All)' (http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/version-independent-all-resource-types|5.0.0), och en kod krävs från denna värdemängd  (error message = Cannot invoke "String.equals(Object)" because "system" is null)
SearchParameter/tk-endpoint-listed-by: SearchParameter.base[0]: Det angivna värdet ('Endpoint') hittades inte i värdemängden 'Version Independent Resource Types (All)' (http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/version-independent-all-resource-types|5.0.0), och en kod krävs från denna värdemängd  (error message = Cannot invoke "String.equals(Object)" because "system" is null)
SearchParameter/tk-endpoint-listed-by: SearchParameter.target[0]: Det angivna värdet ('Organization') hittades inte i värdemängden 'Version Independent Resource Types (All)' (http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/version-independent-all-resource-types|5.0.0), och en kod krävs från denna värdemängd  (error message = Cannot invoke "String.equals(Object)" because "system" is null)

# Logical models (TKIndexpost, TKAPISpecification, TKVardOchOmsorgstagare) get
# their `.type` set to their own canonical URL, per FHIR's own convention for
# logical models that don't map onto a concrete data type (this is standard
# FSH `Logical:` behaviour, not a mistake). That makes every element's
# generated `.path` start with that URL, which trips the eld-20 "first path
# component should be UpperCamelCase" invariant on every single element (22
# occurrences across the three logical models). The invariant's own text
# explicitly carves this out: "Logical models may be less concerned about
# this implication." Confirmed against the real build via PR #1.
Begränsning misslyckades: eld-20: 'The first component of the path should be UpperCamelCase.  Additional components (following a '.') should be lowerCamelCase.  If this syntax is not adhered to, code generation tools may be broken. Logical models may be less concerned about this implication. (path.matches('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}(\.[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}(\[x])?)*$'))' (definierad i http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ElementDefinition)

# Same root cause as the Sweden-display-name suppression above (offline
# `-tx n/a` build can't reach a terminology server to validate
# urn:iso:std:iso:3166 codes), but a newer IG Publisher version phrases it
# differently, so the existing entry didn't actually match. Recurs once per
# resource that carries `^jurisdiction` (18 occurrences) — acceptable.
En definition för CodeSystem 'urn:iso:std:iso:3166' kunde inte hittas, så koden kan inte valideras
